// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / constraints / parameter
function copy<T: Clone>(value: T): T {
//            ^ entity.name.type.parameter.ds
    value.clone()
}

// types / constraints / where
function merge<T, U>(left: T, right: U): T where (T: Merge<U>, U: Clone) {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    left.merge(right.clone())
}
